metadata.gitb:name: European Patient Summary: validation and exchange
metadata.gitb:description: eps-001: the system under test sends a European Patient Summary and matchbox validates it. eps-002: the system under test finds and retrieves a patient summary from the test bed (ITI-67, ITI-68).

gitb:actor.gitb:name: DocumentSource
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The system that produces the patient summary (system under test).

gitb:actor.gitb:name: DocumentConsumer
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The system that finds and retrieves a patient summary (system under test). EU Health Data API, ITI-67 and ITI-68.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: Validator
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: matchbox as the validation service of the test bed, at @MATCHBOX_ITB@
